people.name: Dan
people.line: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.

people.name: Eltekeh
people.line: City in Dan's territory; later given to the Levites

people.name: Gibbethon
people.line: A Levitical city in the territory of Dan.

translations.web: Out of the tribe of Dan, Elteke with its pasture lands, Gibbethon with its pasture lands,
translations.bsb: From the tribe of Dan they were given Elteke, Gibbethon,
translations.kjv: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh with her suburbs, Gibbethon with her suburbs,
translations.asv: And out of the tribe of Dan, Elteke with its suburbs, Gibbethon with its suburbs,
